words.sense: defensible in light of available evidence
misconceptions: A defensible claim need not be proved beyond all doubt.

words.sense: weakly supported or based on a slight connection
misconceptions: A coherent-sounding story can still rest on almost nothing.

semantic_axes.description: Tenable claims have enough support to withstand reasonable criticism; tenuous claims rest on weak or slight support.

edges.boundary_rule: Tenable claims have enough support to withstand reasonable criticism; tenuous claims rest on weak or slight support.
irrelevant_clues: how many people repeat the claim

misconceptions.M1: A defensible claim need not be proved beyond all doubt.
misconceptions.M2: A coherent-sounding story can still rest on almost nothing.
misconceptions.M3: Do not stick with an old answer after decisive evidence changes, or let surface distractions override the boundary.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Priya’s claim?

beats.text: Priya argued the cashier charged too much because her receipt showed a higher price than a nearby shelf label.
beats.decisive_clue: a receipt and shelf label appear to support the claim
beats.reason: The initial comparison gives a reasonable basis for the complaint.

beats.text: The label was for a smaller package; the receipt matched the price printed beneath her own item.
beats.decisive_clue: the shelf label applied to another item
beats.reason: The corrected comparison removes the evidence supporting this specific overcharging claim.

chains.feedback_short: The key is the shelf label applied to another item; the corrected comparison removes the evidence supporting this specific overcharging claim.
chains.feedback_deep: Tenable concerns defensible in light of available evidence; tenuous concerns weakly supported or based on a slight connection. The corrected comparison removes the evidence supporting this specific overcharging claim.
chains.contrast_rule: Tenable: records directly back the claim; tenuous: only a coincidence supports it.

beats.text: Noah blamed the bus delay on a strike after seeing one worker in a protest shirt.

beats.text: The transport company confirmed that its drivers had stopped work that morning, delaying his route.
beats.decisive_clue: a direct confirmation of the cause of the delay
beats.reason: An official confirmation directly supports that explanation.

beats.text: Kojo claimed a popular singer would visit his town because a stranger posted a vague emoji.
